title: S2.5 plan-review boundary (red-teaming-implementation-plan output)
description: Boundary contract for the S2.5 adversarial plan-review gate (plan-review). Permissive stage boundary (additionalProperties true): superset envelope over the skill's strict output schema; required mirrors the YAML required_fields. Verdict routing (engine/policies.py): PROCEED releases the fan-out; REVISE and BLOCK both feed the stage loop_back to tl-design (max_loops 1, reviewer findings threaded into the re-run); a non-proceed verdict after the cap aborts the run (HardFail); reroute routes as rework; hard-fail fails. The enum is a superset accepting the uppercase PROCEED/REVISE/BLOCK the live skill emits and the lowercase pass/pass-with-caveats/reroute/hard-fail set; unknown vocabulary fails closed to a human.

verdict.description: Advisory red-team verdict; a named human confirms on HardFail. PROCEED/REVISE/BLOCK is the live skill's form.

steelman.description: The strongest good-faith case for the plan, written before findings to counter dismissal bias.

bias_checks.description: Self-audit notes (e.g. steelman-first ordering, author==critic heterogeneity caveat, approval-momentum resistance).

confidence.description: Reviewer confidence; a number in [0,1] or a low/medium/high label.

human_view.description: Additive render-policy hint for the human-review layer; absence == default (generic tree).
